findings.summary: A red minus, a striped red tax block and 'almost 30,000 to tax' appear before any reassurance, which can scare the user away from the fund.
There is no age input, so the 3-year rule for retirees is not applied. The default 5 years may show tax that does not apply to the user.
The paragraph under the chart has too many numbers, and the reader can't tell which one is the answer.
Pale grey text on a black background is hard to read even when enlarged.
The example track uses English letters and jargon (S&P500, מסלול מדד).
The bar colours are hard to tell apart, and no sentence explains what the chart means.
The amounts at the top of screen 2 have no visible context.
Codes like KH-19 and PF-18 in 'שווה לדעת' mean nothing to an ordinary reader.
